title: SQL screening test
task: Using the synthetic hospital operations and pharmacy-order data, calculate department encounter counts and mean length of stay, pharmacy class order-line counts and value, and identify orphan orders. Use safe pre-aggregation to avoid join fan-out.
deliverable: One SQL file plus result extracts and a short validation note.

title: Excel / reporting test
task: Create a department summary using PivotTables or equivalent formulas, validate lookup completeness, define three KPIs and produce a one-page operational report.
deliverable: Workbook with raw data, calculations, KPI dictionary, checks and summary page.

title: Python data-quality test
task: Write a pandas script that profiles the supplied datasets, checks unique IDs, ranges, missingness, temporal logic and orphan references, and exports issue tables plus a machine-readable summary.
deliverable: Runnable script, requirements file, outputs and execution instructions.

title: Healthcare interpretation test
task: Explain why an order is not administration or adherence, why a supplied readmission flag is not automatically a validated rate, and how denominator and follow-up definitions change interpretation.
deliverable: One-page plain-language interpretation for a non-technical stakeholder.

title: Remote client simulation
task: A client asks for a dashboard by tomorrow, but the readmission definition and refresh timestamp are missing and orphan order records are present. Clarify scope, state risks, agree an interim deliverable and write a handoff.
deliverable: Clarification message, analysis plan, QA log, interim findings and handoff note.
